title: 卡兹克·叶片小收藏
description: 紫色螳螂怪卡兹克收拢翼壳与镰形前肢，低头观察三片彩叶，保持友好卡通形态。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Kha'Zix is a purple insectoid Void creature with a narrow triangular head, large bright eyes, segmented armor, folded wing cases, powerful hind legs, and two distinctive scythe-like forelimbs. Preserve his mantis silhouette but round the pointed edges and keep the mouth closed and friendly. The curved forelimbs are folded harmlessly against the body, without attack motion, gore, or frightening detail.
art_direction.scene: He crouches beside a low flat stone and studies three colorful fallen leaves arranged like a tiny collection. One rounded forelimb steadies the stone edge while a small foot points toward a particularly interesting leaf. A fern and a soft tree shape suggest a bright clearing, with wings closed and every limb clearly separated inside the square.
art_direction.palette: violet shell, teal accents, autumn peach, leaf gold
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
